found.quote: All AI use must comply with:
Ensuring equitable access to AI-enabled learning opportunities
found.anchor: 3. UCB Approach to AI in Education

found.quote: This policy will therefore be kept under regular review (at least annually) to ensure it remains relevant, effective, and aligned with sector guidance.
Outputs are checked for accuracy and bias
Where AI contributes to research or outputs, its use must be acknowledged and verified.

unsure.quote: AI must not be used in ways that misrepresent competence or authenticity.
unsure.why: Employer-facing misrepresentation; no misconduct, plagiarism or own-work label.

unsure.quote: Students must ensure that any materials submitted to employers (including applications, portfolios, and assessments) accurately reflect their own abilities, experience, and professional voice.
unsure.why: Own-work principle but aimed at employer submissions.

unsure.quote: Supporting staff and students to become AI-literate
unsure.why: Commitment is general; no course or resource described.

unsure.quote: Reflections on the quality of AI outputs should be explored
unsure.why: Condition where AI permitted; not clearly mandatory or critique task.

unsure.quote: UCB’s Using AI ethically within Assessments frames this guidance.
unsure.why: Points to a document without telling students to comply.

unsure.quote: ensuring a fair, consistent, and proportionate response.
unsure.why: General fairness wording; no specific safeguards or appeal rights.
